system.description: A Focus for a mystic whose unarmed techniques draw on an otherworldly source of power.

abilities.name: No Need for Weapons
abilities.description: Your unarmed attacks inflict 2 additional damage.

abilities.name: Mystic Hand
abilities.description: Your mystic-source unarmed attacks deal 1 additional damage; once per round, spend 3 Speed to reduce a wound by one step.

abilities.name: Supernatural Leap
abilities.description: When you jump, move twice as far as normal horizontally or vertically.

abilities.name: Safe Fall
abilities.description: Ignore one wound caused by a fall.

abilities.name: Surging Hand
abilities.description: Project your mystic source at a target within short range with a Speed attack that deals 4 damage on a success.

abilities.name: Perfecting the Body
abilities.description: Your daily kata grant immunity to fear, mental control, disease, and poison.

abilities.name: Mystic Flurry
abilities.description: Your unarmed attacks infused with your mystic source deal 1 additional damage.

abilities.name: Mystic Step
abilities.description: Instantly transport yourself to a visible location within long range, with an extra unarmed attack if you appear near a foe.

abilities.name: Exploding Hand
abilities.description: Attack a target within long range and two nearby additional targets with your mystic source, dealing 4 damage on a hit or 1 on a miss.

abilities.name: Resonant Palm
abilities.description: Forge a ten-day mystic connection that lets you transfer a wound or make an eased attack against the linked creature.

abilities.name: Perfected Form
abilities.description: Until a one-hour recovery, gain 3 points to distribute among your Pools and deal 3 additional damage with unarmed attacks.

abilities.name: Lethal Strike
abilities.description: A swift melee or ranged weapon attack deals 7 additional damage on a hit.
